description: The seven P1-7 scenarios. Rows of scenario Sn are exactly the events_bc rows whose unique_id and the links_bc rows whose event1_id start with row_prefix; reference tables (subjects, mv_subject_hierarchy, master_mill) are shared. `expect` is derived by hand from the SQL and Go source, independently of the goldens; the L3 tests assert the Go implementation agrees with it.

scenarios.title: New event
scenarios.description: S1-E01 is valid, unsynced and absent from Dgraph; an unsynced valid link S1-E01 -> S1-E02 makes it eligible. It must be created through a blank node whose returned uid is then used by the link. Its values exercise string escaping (quotes, backslash, newline, non-ASCII), whitespace trimming, a NULL nullable column, a non-trivial jsonb src_path and a numeric beyond float64 precision.

scenarios.title: Updated event
scenarios.description:
S2-E01 is already in Dgraph and was updated in Postgres: one value changed, values cleared by NULL, by an empty string, by whitespace only and by an empty jsonb object, a join-derived value changed (uml_id -> mill_id) and a join-derived group cleared (location_id with no subject). Every cleared field must produce `

*` in the same mutation as the sets.

scenarios.title: Invalidated event
scenarios.description: S3-E01 is in Dgraph and now status='invalid': the removal path must emit `<uid> * * .`. Its incoming edge (S3-E02 -> S3-E01) is removed by the links path rewriting S3-E02, which keeps S3-E02 -> S3-E03; its outgoing edge disappears with the node and is not resurrected. S3-E05 is invalid but was never loaded: no delete, still stamped.

scenarios.title: Link added
scenarios.description: A new unsynced link S4-E01 -> S4-E02 joins two synced events. S4-E01 already has two links, so its whole link set is deleted and re-added (three links). The new link's facets exercise omission: NULL and empty versions and a whitespace-only role are omitted, while qty=0 is emitted.

scenarios.title: Link invalidated
scenarios.description: Link S5-E01 -> S5-E02 is now status='invalid' and unsynced: removalQuery returns its id (stamp only) and the links path drops the edge while keeping S5-E01 -> S5-E03. Link S5-E04 -> S5-E03 has status NULL and is unsynced: removalQuery ignores it, but the links path drops its edge and stamps it.

scenarios.title: Event2-only change
scenarios.description: S6-E02 changed in Postgres and appears only as event2 (of the synced link S6-E01 -> S6-E02). It is upserted, and S6-E01 is pulled into the links path by linkEvent1IDsQuery's third UNION branch and rewritten.

scenarios.title: Event with no links
scenarios.description: S7-E01 is new and S7-E02 is an updated in-graph event; neither has any link. eventIDsQuery requires a valid link, so neither is written to Dgraph and neither is stamped: both stay pending (sync_time NULL).
